$comment: T256 -- documents are authored in Markdown, diagrams in Mermaid. Owner instruction 2026-08-22:
Scoped to TRACKED files only. Untracked scratch is not governed -- a gate that fires on a file
nobody committed teaches people to ignore it.
The distinction that makes this landable: a DOCUMENT is authored prose, an ASSET is an output or
a binary. A PDF is a deliverable, an image is an asset, a stylesheet is code. None of those is a
document authored in the wrong format. What the gate looks for is prose or a diagram whose
SOURCE was written in something other than Markdown or Mermaid.

not_documents.$comment: Assets and outputs. Present for the record, so the boundary is declared and not re-argued.
